facts.text: I want to track my expenses for the past month.
I bought a gift for my sister's birthday last month on the 15th.
I bought my sister a silver necklace from a new jewelry store downtown.

The baby clothes and soft toy cost around $50.
I bought a personalized baby blanket from Etsy for my friend Emily's baby shower.
